title: Do GitHub repo mahine ke 9 arab token
content:
Kisi ne do GitHub repos daal diye hain.
Har mahine 9 arab muft tokens.
Na credit card, na payment.
Install karo, aur chalu.

Pehla, Free LLM API.
Mahine ke 7.4 arab tokens.
Doosra, OmniRoute.
Upar se 1.6 arab aur.
Dono mil kar, har mahine muft mein poori startup ka code likh sakte ho.
Setup mein kuch minute lagte hain.

API bill pe abhi bhi paise jala rahe ho, to mehnga code kar rahe ho.
Comment karo, repo.
Main dono links aur poora setup guide DM kar dunga.

Bahut logon ne pucha, main AI se content kaise banata hoon.
Maine ispe ek ebook banayi hai.
Woh meri muft AI community ke andar hai.
Yeh QR scan karo.
Ya mattis.ai search karke join karo.
